name: Brastias

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brastias was an Arthurian knight. He served Gorlois, the duke of Cornwall. He helped the disguised Uther Pendragon reach the chamber of Igraine, the duke's wife. The magician Merlin had changed Uther's face so he looked like Gorlois home from battle. This knight welcomed Uther inside on Merlin's behalf. Arthur was conceived with Igraine that same night. After Arthur became king, Brastias ranked among his most loyal nobles.

okr.objective: Describe Brastias, the Arthurian knight who aided Uther Pendragon.
key_results: Brastias served Gorlois, the duke of Cornwall.
He helped the disguised Uther reach the chamber of Igraine.
He worked in league with the magician Merlin.
He became one of Arthur's strongest supporters.
